assumptions.statement: Official regulatory-control geometry, road redlines, heritage controls and water blue lines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Keep constraints.geojson empty and recalculate all affected layers after cleared official controls arrive.

assumptions.statement: Official overall and three key-area polygons are unavailable; repository provisional geometry is used only for generation and discussion.
assumptions.impact: All geometry, areas, figures and PDFs must be regenerated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: The complete land-use partition is a conceptual functional diagram, not an approved land-use plan.
assumptions.impact: Codes organize proposal roles only; professional teams must reconcile them with the statutory plan.

assumptions.statement: No cleared building survey, ownership, height, age or structural data is available.
assumptions.impact: Twelve footprints represent removable one-storey service kits, not demolition, retention or construction decisions.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, sections, traffic counts and station access surveys are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Lines express access relationships only; alignment, crossings and feasibility require transport and accessibility review.

assumptions.statement: Implemented park, water, heritage and ecological control boundaries are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Green overlays do not claim existing park limits or permission for construction.

assumptions.statement: The twelve 100 m gate prototypes are not parcel selections and have no operator agreement.
assumptions.impact: Locations and areas are low-confidence concepts; each needs field observation, ownership and accessibility audit.

assumptions.statement: Phases are cumulative program gates rather than construction schedules or funding commitments.
assumptions.impact: Advance only after published evidence, community feedback and responsible human approval.

assumptions.statement: No observed account-free completion rate, human fallback rate or personal-data field count exists.
assumptions.impact: All Guest Mode performance metrics remain unknown; numeric values are targets, never achievements.

assumptions.statement: Guest Mode is a design and product-standard proposal, not legal advice.
assumptions.impact: Every deployment needs context-specific privacy, security, accessibility and sector review.

assumptions.statement: OSM context is volunteer-maintained and not survey-grade.
assumptions.impact: Use only for orientation; verify station entrances, names and paths in the field and with official data.
